384:t_022:7.en:
$n
「I'm going to beat you down and get Miss $$スズネ$$ back!」

384:t_022:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha!」

384:t_022:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It was worth coming all this way.」

384:t_022:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n... Next time, I'll bring $$西条涼音$$ to you, just as you wished.」

384:t_022:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Though I make no promises about what condition she'll be in.」

384:t_022:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You've served me well up to today.」

384:t_022:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「As your reward, I shall release the hatred inside you.」

384:t_023:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What's that guy going to do!?」

384:t_023:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He said he'd release the hatred, but...」

384:t_023:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The aura coming off $$ギルター$$...!」

384:t_023:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I am $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! Everyone who insults me will die!!」

384:t_023:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Fine hatred, $$ギルター$$. Raising you was worth the trouble after all.」

384:t_023:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Putting you, a lump of inferiority complex and jealousy, under $$サルディアス$$ was exactly the right way to raise you.」

384:t_023:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! You amplified the hatred of your own subordinate $$ギルター$$ and destroyed his mind!」

384:t_023:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That guy...! He pulled that trick again!」

384:t_023:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I leave the rest to you, $$ギルター$$. ...Though even if you defeat $c, you have no future.」

384:t_023:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't get cocky, $n. Your awakening is still unstable.」

384:t_023:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「With the slightest trigger, the backlash will kill your mind... Can you endure that?」

384:t_023:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I look forward to meeting you again, $c! Next time, I'll invite Miss $$スズネ$$, whom you all love so much!」

384:t_025:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「I came to confirm that the powers governing $$オリジン・ロー$$ are coming together, but I got to see something interesting...」

384:t_025:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Are you talking about the $$スフィア$$s!?」

384:t_025:4.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「That is not all, $$マーズ$$...! I cannot overlook your power awakening any further!」

384:t_025:5.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「A fine opportunity. I'll dispose of you here!」

384:t_025:7.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Heh... Some have been nicely swallowed by the darkness.」

384:t_025:9.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「In your current half-baked state, you can't defeat even him! Farewell, $$マーズ$$!」

384:t_026:0.en:
$$タケル$$
(Darkness... Is he talking about my brother's power...?)

384:t_026:1.en:
$$タケル$$
(If so, what will become of me, having taken it in...)

384:t_026:2.en:
$n
「Let's do this, $$タケル$$...! He's not the same $$ギルター$$ as before!」

384:t_026:4.en:
$$葵$$
「In short, he's a berserker ruled by hatred, right!? No way we lose to a guy like that!」

384:t_026:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「We'll take care of the army of darkness and $$ギルター$$ all at once!」

384:t_026:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, begin the attack! Your target is $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!」

384:t_027:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I am $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! The general with the greatest strategic mind in $$サイデリアル$$, the man worthy of deputy commander of $$アンタレス$$!」

384:t_027:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「All you worthless fools, bow down before me! $$サルディアス$$, $$バルビエル$$, even Emperor $$アウストラリス$$!」

384:t_028:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Facing death, he broke free of $$バルビエル$$'s control...」

384:t_028:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「N-no...! I don't want to die! I...!」

384:t_029:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The poison $$ギルター$$ spread didn't last long. The residents' confusion is settling down as well.」

384:t_029:2.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The soldiers left at the $$ターミナル・ベース$$ also seem to have pulled out.」

384:t_029:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「With this, we can call the northern Central Continent a complete victory for Earth's side.」

384:t_029:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I doubt the Empire on $$蒼の地球$$ will let today's victory go unanswered.」

384:t_029:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$バルビエル$$ has made his move too... The next battle will be even bigger.」

384:t_029:7.en:
$$シン$$
「Suits me fine. That's what we came to $$翠の地球$$ for.」

384:t_029:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$オペレーション・エクリプス$$... So it's finally entering the second phase.」

384:t_029:9.en:
$n
(Please wait for us, Miss $$スズネ$$... We'll definitely come and save you.)

384:t_029:10.en:
$n
(No matter what kind of trap $$バルビエル$$ has set...)

384:t_030:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Don't make me laugh, $c! By shooting down our comrades, you've proven your own incompetence!」

384:t_030:1.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Shooting down the Resistance has made the residents' panic even worse.」

384:t_031:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「We've succeeded in neutralizing the Resistance.」

384:t_031:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「This is the only method we have right now. Take the fighting power away from the other units the same way.」

384:t_100:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hang in there, you guys! I'll save you right away!」

384:t_100:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Go, go, darling! But no overdoing it today!」
